claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md, RANK-BRIDGE.md) returns P with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, under heuristics H1, H1', H-EA, H2, H3, H-R, H-SM, H4, H4u, H-X and reached-ideal ensemble H5 (explicitly including de Bruijn local-density correction, closed-form 1D/2D 4-prime 62-bit NTT, fixed-instance H3 4-param hard-capped LA, H-R/H-X rank bridge with live unplanted 4-SM BW + 1D-kernel Hankel+Horner + 3-stack zero-loss repurge_stack verification, i.i.d. single-cell D_skew=2^21 exact-LLL boot with RET_BOOT=0.50, exact seeded peeling closure h=0.256845 (post_peel_cols_lost=post_merge_cols_lost=0), explicit per-node special-q norm cutoff with expected survivor/ECM work under H-EA, NB(1.5) reached-ideal H5 with B_max=10 strictly i.i.d. root-only fresh-e_j boot retries (k=1 inside DAG, exact Wald expected work) behind a hard combined-log meter t=2^121.4 (Markov <= 0.000167) with unconditional Boole union bound, multi-factor ECM loops, and 100-round MR), at expected total classical work at most 1+(K/2^64)(2^110.8572184875+2^66) < 2^109.499047312532 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000): an expectation over the challenge and fresh coins of the one attack on the one target, not a bound on every single run. A run gate (u < K = 7195640534291446254, (K/2^64) x 0.999804 >= 0.39) precedes an opened run that succeeds with probability at least 0.999804 (unconditional Boole union bound; metered row sum <= 2^121.400727694701 units with combined-log meter t=2^121.4). Nothing is amortized. Analytic exploratory claim.
